name: Etched Rune
summary: In Coldridge Valley, novice dwarf hunters receive a carved summons from Sten Stoutarm. It directs them to Thorgas Grimson inside Anvilmar for training in the hunt.

sections.title: A Summons in Stone
sections.body: As you help Sten Stoutarm face threats around Coldridge Valley, he gives you the Etched Rune. Dwarven mentors favor carved runes for formal messages, rather than spoken orders or plain parchment. The stone tells you to take stock of your early work and report indoors at Anvilmar for deeper instruction in the hunt.

sections.title: Traditions of the Dun Morogh Hunter
sections.body: At Anvilmar, the Etched Rune marks a hunter's entry into formal discipline. Thorgas Grimson teaches that mountaineering and survival in Khaz Modan demand respect for the harsh land. Hunters learn to read tracks in bitter snowdrifts, care for their weapons and ammunition, and understand the wild beasts roaming the crags. The rune marks a hunter's first step from a lone wanderer with a gun to an apprentice among Anvilmar's veteran pathfinders.

faq.answer: The Etched Rune is an inscribed stone tablet that invites novice hunters in Coldridge Valley to seek formal training with Thorgas Grimson inside Anvilmar.
Thorgas Grimson sends the Etched Rune. Sten Stoutarm, a mountaineer, hands it to you after you prove your basic competence outside Anvilmar.

faq.q: Where do I take the Etched Rune?
aliases: who do i turn it in to
faq.answer: Bring the Etched Rune to Thorgas Grimson in the great hall inside Anvilmar, in Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: Why do dwarves use runes instead of letters?
faq.answer: Dwarven culture values stonework, tradition, and enduring craft. Carved runes let messages and sacred instructions endure Dun Morogh's bitter winds and harsh elements better than fragile parchment.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the rune to Thorgas Grimson?
faq.answer: Thorgas welcomes you into the ranks of dwarven trackers. He explains how to survive in the frozen crags, care for your gear, and respect wild beasts before offering training in basic hunter techniques.

faq.q: Can any class receive the Etched Rune?
faq.answer: Only dwarf hunters beginning their journey in Coldridge Valley receive the Etched Rune. Other classes receive distinct tokens that direct them to their own mentors in Anvilmar.

angles.text: As a hunter, the Etched Rune begins your journey in Dun Morogh and introduces you to Thorgas Grimson and the dwarven traditions of tracking, weapon care, and wilderness survival.
As a dwarf, you see the value placed on stonework, tradition, and enduring craft in the carved runes used for formal messages.
